scope: Exact local source bodies after Searchfox discovery; UA excerpts are not a native matched-rule trace.

excerpts.start: # font-family potentially changes keyword font sizes
excerpts.end_exclusive: # Affects all colors due to forced-colors mode.
excerpts.text:
# font-family potentially changes keyword font sizes, we want to apply text
    # un-scaling after it.
    "-x-text-scale": ["font-family"],

[-x-text-scale]
type = "XTextScale"
initial = "computed::XTextScale::All"
struct = "font"
servo_pref = "layout.unimplemented"
animation_type = "none"
enabled_in = ""
has_effect_on_gecko_scrollbars = false
spec = "Internal (not web-exposed)"
affects = "layout"
